headline: European Gas Prices Soar 30% as Qatar Halts LNG Output
summary: Qatar, the world's second-largest LNG exporter, has ceased production after military attacks on operating facilities. Europe's benchmark gas prices rose about 70 per cent since Friday's close, according to the report.
why: Qatar is a major LNG supplier, and Europe relies on LNG imports to replace pipeline gas. Supply disruptions there quickly lift European gas benchmarks and power costs.
why_moved: Qatar stopped LNG production after attacks on operating facilities, cutting a major supply source. European benchmark gas prices rose roughly 70 per cent since Friday's close.
